channel.title: Pyor Blog
channel.description: Notes from the pyor: on the review bottleneck, reviewing large and AI-generated PRs, and making code review fast again.

item.title: AI Writes Code Faster Than You Can Review It
item.description: Authoring got 50% faster; reviewing didn't. Why the AI code review bottleneck is structural, what it does to teams, and the three places to attack it.
item.author: hello@pyor.review (Othman Shareef)

item.title: GitHub PR Review Alternatives in 2026: An Honest Comparison
item.description: GitHub PR review alternatives compared honestly: Graphite's stacks, Stage's AI chapters, Pyor's native surface, or just pulling locally. Which fits your team?
item.author: hello@pyor.review (Othman Shareef)

item.title: Reviewing AI-Generated Code: A Practical Checklist
item.description: How to review AI-generated code: a practical checklist covering intent match, hallucinated APIs, untested edges, security surface, and testing the tests.
item.author: hello@pyor.review (Othman Shareef)

item.title: How Big Should a Pull Request Be?
item.description: The research-backed answer on pull request size: under ~400 changed lines, smaller is better. Where the number comes from, when to break it, how to split.
item.author: hello@pyor.review (Othman Shareef)

item.title: How to Review Large Pull Requests (Without Losing Your Mind)
item.description: A practical, step-by-step method for reviewing large pull requests: triage the files that matter, review in passes, and keep your place in a 40-file diff.
item.author: hello@pyor.review (Othman Shareef)

item.title: Why Are Pull Requests So Hard to Review?
item.description: Pull request review is slow because reading code is harder than writing it, and the tools make it worse. The four real causes, and what actually helps.
item.author: hello@pyor.review (Othman Shareef)
